variables.name: APP_NAME
variables.description: Application name for the Realtime service. Required by the Elixir/Erlang app for node naming.

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: PostgreSQL host via Railway private networking. References the postgres service's private domain.

variables.name: DB_PORT
variables.description: PostgreSQL port. References the postgres service's POSTGRES_PORT.

variables.name: DB_USER
variables.description: PostgreSQL username. References the postgres service's POSTGRES_USER.

variables.name: DB_PASSWORD
variables.description: PostgreSQL password. References the postgres service's POSTGRES_PASSWORD.

variables.name: DB_NAME
variables.description: PostgreSQL database name. References the postgres service's POSTGRES_DB.

variables.name: DB_AFTER_CONNECT_QUERY
variables.description: SQL executed after connecting to PostgreSQL. Sets the search path to the _realtime schema.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: JWT secret for Realtime. References the auth service's JWT_SECRET so all services share the same signing key.

variables.name: API_JWT_SECRET
variables.description: JWT secret for the Realtime API. Mirrors JWT_SECRET from the auth service.

variables.name: SECRET_KEY_BASE
variables.description: Elixir secret key base for crypto operations (session signing, CSRF tokens). Auto-generated 64-char secret.

variables.name: ERL_AFLAGS
variables.description: Erlang distribution flags. inet_tcp ensures standard TCP clustering works on Railway.

variables.name: ENABLE_TAILSCALE
variables.description: Enable Tailscale-based clustering. Set to false for Railway (uses standard TCP).

variables.name: DNS_NODES
variables.description: DNS node names for Erlang clustering. Leave empty for single-node deployment.
